data.notes: Artifact: Giantsbane, artifact, +1 short sword: INT 4; AL N; Banes: giants (hunter; sword can detect bane creatures within 100’, even if invisible or otherwise concealed, and can overcome magical defenses against detection as if with a +10 Will save or spell check); communication: simple urges; SP detect magic 1/day.
